name: Republic Day Flower Show, Lalbagh
blurb: A themed flower show in the Glass House, usually around Republic Day.

name: Makar Sankranti & Ellu Bella
blurb: Harvest festival: sesame-jaggery sweets, kite days and the Gavipuram sun alignment.

name: Chitra Santhe
blurb: A one-day art fair where artists from across India set up on the road.

name: Bengaluru International Film Festival
blurb: A week of world cinema and Kannada film spotlights, typically in Feb-March.

name: Ugadi
blurb: Kannada New Year, with bevu-bella and festive meals. Falls in March or April.

name: Bengaluru Karaga
blurb: A centuries-old procession that winds through the old city on a full-moon night.

name: Ramzan food nights
blurb: Seasonal night food streets; the month shifts each year.

name: TCS World 10K Bengaluru
blurb: A large road run that closes parts of Cubbon Park-Central roads.

name: Mango & Jackfruit Melas
blurb: Summer fruit fairs by the horticulture department and farmers' groups.

name: Monsoon lake & bird walks
blurb: Community-led birding and lake walks; check local nature groups.

name: Independence Day Flower Show, Lalbagh
blurb: The second flower show of the year.

name: Ganesha Chaturthi
blurb: Pandals, processions and lake-friendly clay idol campaigns.

name: St. Mary's Feast
blurb: Annual feast around 8 September with a fair around the basilica.

name: Navaratri & Dasara
where: Across the city; Mysuru is the big one
blurb: Golu displays, cultural programmes and a day trip option to Mysuru Dasara.

name: Deepavali
blurb: Lights, sweets and fireworks - check noise and cracker rules.

name: Kadalekai Parishe (Groundnut Fair)
blurb: The traditional groundnut fair around Karthika masa; dates are set by the lunar calendar.

name: Bengaluru Tech Summit
blurb: The city's flagship tech and startup gathering, usually in November.

name: Bangalore Literature Festival
blurb: A winter weekend of authors, poets and publishers (late in the year).

name: Ranga Shankara Theatre Festival
blurb: A multi-day festival of national and international theatre (dates vary).

name: Christmas lights & midnight mass
blurb: Church services, lights and bakeries open late.

name: New Year's Eve
blurb: Big nights out with traffic diversions and tight enforcement.

name: Bengaluru Habba & cultural weekends
blurb: Music, dance and craft programmes in winter; watch for announcements.

name: Carnatic music season
blurb: A winter season of kutcheris and festival concerts.

name: Book fairs & Avenue Road
blurb: Check for periodic book fairs; Avenue Road is always good for secondhand.

name: Weekday founder & dev meetups
blurb: Year-round developer, design and founder meetups - find them in community groups and event apps.

name: Cubbon Park morning communities
blurb: Running, yoga, chess and book-swap groups meet on weekend mornings.
